title: $p$-adic Congruences of Generalized Euler Numbers and Relations to Even Zeta Values
summary: Generalized Euler numbers have previously been studied mainly from a combinatorial viewpoint. The purpose of this paper is to explore them from $p$-adic and analytic perspectives. To this end, we introduce congruential Euler numbers, a new family extending generalized Euler numbers. We establish several $p$-adic congruences for these numbers, including an answer to a conjecture related to Lehmer numbers.
